home.title: The systems your organisation runs on, built and secured by one team.
home.lead: CyBarq is a technology company in Amman working across cybersecurity, digital engineering, artificial intelligence and infrastructure. We take responsibility for the whole system: how it is designed, how it runs and how it is protected.
home.practicesLead: Each practice stands on its own. Together they cover everything between an idea and a system that runs securely in production.
home.statementBody: Systems that are designed with care, built to be maintained and tested by people whose job is to break them. That is what done properly means to us.
home.selectedLead: A penetration test, an incident, a platform that needs building, an AI feature that has to be trusted. These are the engagements we are asked for most often.
home.registrationAlt: Logos of the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship and the National Cyber Security Center of Jordan
home.ctaTitle: Tell us what you are working on
home.ctaBody: A short message is enough. We will reply with questions, not a sales pitch, and we will tell you honestly whether we are the right team for it.
